- trend_slope: mean -0.0146, std 0.7035, trend -0.0091

The trends show increasing ac1 (autocorrelation at lag 1) and increasing low_freq_power, which are classic early warning signals of critical transitions/tipping points. Increasing variance (variance_log_ratio trend 0.1164) is also a warning sign.
